figure.caption: Two studies of the same true effect: chance misses in all directions, bias misses in one direction every time.

items.title: Chance
items.text: Scatter around the truth. Repeat the study and the misses fall on all sides of it.

items.title: Bias
items.text: One systematic pull. Repeat the study and the misses land in the same wrong place.

verdict.text: Repeats average chance away; they only re-print bias.
